<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C8H14ON), the DBE count (3), the presence of one carbonyl group, a C=C double bond (two sp² carbons), and five methyl groups (two of them chemically equivalent), the molecule can be thought of as being assembled from a carbonyl‑nitrogen fragment, an alkene fragment, and five separate methyl fragments. Representing each of these as SMILES gives the list below.</thought>
<final_answer>['C(=O)N', 'C=C', 'C', 'C', 'C', 'C', 'C']</final_answer>
